title: workflow_execution
description: How workflow jobs run (docs/design/CONFIG_HOMES.md, C10; docs/design/CODE_TO_DATA_S4_S8.md, I7): the longest a run request may hold its answer, how much history a workflow keeps, the bounds a saved workflow template must meet, and the limits on what a job's result may hold. The code holds the ceiling of each key; a value above it is cut to it.

max_wait_s.description: Longest `Prefer: wait=N` a run request may ask for, in seconds (gateway/workflow_run.py, RUN_CEILINGS).

history_depth.description: How many saved revisions of one workflow the registry keeps and lists (gateway/workflow_run.py, RUN_CEILINGS).

bounds.description: What a saved workflow's template may hold (gateway/workflow_run.py, RUN_CEILINGS). A key left out keeps the code's ceiling.

legacy_output_collection.description: Whether a route that declares no output selector may still collect its outputs the old way (docs/design/CODE_TO_DATA_S2.md, D5). Only a literal false turns it off.

result_limits.description: Limits on a job's result (gateway/result_bundle.py, ResultLimits). A key left out keeps the code's ceiling.
